column1: # Identity of the corpora the shipped models and published numbers were built
# from. data/ is gitignored, so this is the only way to confirm that a corpus on
# disk is the one measured. Check with: python scripts/corpus_fingerprint.py --check
# Hashes are over SORTED lines: paragraph order is not part of a corpus's
# identity, because the train/val/test split is by content hash and n-gram counts
# are order-independent. So a corpus rebuilt with
# `fetch_wikipedia_samples.py --from-pages`, which returns articles in id order,
# fingerprints the same as the random-order original.
